title: Privacy Policy
content_markdown:
## 1. Introduction

Replai (operated by **Junkies Coder**) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data when you use our AI-powered WhatsApp CRM platform ("Service").

By using Replai, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the Service.

---

## 2. Information We Collect

### 2.1 Account Information
- Full name and email address provided during registration
- Password (stored using industry-standard hashing — never in plaintext)
- Profile avatar (optional)
- Organization/workspace name

### 2.2 WhatsApp Business API Data
When you connect your WhatsApp Business account, we process:
- Messages sent and received through the platform
- Contact information (phone numbers, names) imported or synced
- Media files shared within conversations (images, documents, audio)
- Message templates created and submitted for approval
- Delivery and read receipts

### 2.3 Usage and Analytics Data
- Browser type, operating system, and device information
- IP address and approximate location
- Pages visited and features used within the platform
- Session duration and interaction patterns

### 2.4 Cookies and Tracking Technologies
We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. Please see our [Cookie Policy](/legal/cookie-policy) for full details.

---

## 3. How We Use Your Data

We use the collected data for the following purposes:

- **Service Delivery** — To provide, operate, and maintain the Replai platform
- **WhatsApp Messaging** — To send and receive messages on your behalf via the WhatsApp Business API
- **AI Features** — To power AI-assisted replies, chatbots, and automation workflows
- **Account Management** — To manage your workspace, team members, and permissions
- **Customer Support** — To respond to inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and provide assistance
- **Platform Improvement** — To analyze usage patterns and improve features
- **Security** — To detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, and technical issues
- **Legal Compliance** — To comply with applicable laws, regulations, and legal processes

---

## 4. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or United Kingdom, we process your data under the following legal bases:

| Legal Basis | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Contractual necessity** | To provide the Service you signed up for |
| **Legitimate interest** | Platform security, fraud prevention, and analytics |
| **Consent** | Marketing communications and optional AI features |
| **Legal obligation** | Compliance with tax, accounting, and regulatory requirements |

---

## 5. Data Sharing and Third Parties

We do **not** sell your personal data. We share data only with:

- **Meta Platforms, Inc.** — As required to operate the WhatsApp Business API. Meta acts as a data processor for message delivery. Meta's own [Privacy Policy](https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy) governs their processing.
- **Supabase** — Our database and authentication infrastructure provider
- **Hosting Providers** — Cloud infrastructure services (e.g., Vercel) for platform hosting
- **AI Service Providers** — For AI-powered features (data is processed in accordance with their data processing agreements)
- **Legal Authorities** — When required by law, court order, or government regulation

---

## 6. Data Retention

| Data Type | Retention Period |
|---|---|
| Account information | Duration of your account + 30 days after deletion |
| WhatsApp messages | As configured by your workspace (default: 12 months) |
| Contact data | Duration of your account |
| Usage analytics | 24 months (anonymized after 6 months) |
| Audit logs | 12 months |

You may request earlier deletion by contacting us at **privacy@junkiescoder.com**.

---

## 7. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures including:

- End-to-end encryption for WhatsApp messages (provided by Meta)
- TLS/SSL encryption for all data in transit
- AES-256 encryption for data at rest
- Role-based access controls and team permissions
- Row-level security (RLS) at the database level
- Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
- Secure password hashing using bcrypt

---

## 8. Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the following rights:

- **Access** — Request a copy of your personal data
- **Rectification** — Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
- **Deletion** — Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
- **Portability** — Receive your data in a portable format
- **Restriction** — Restrict processing of your data
- **Objection** — Object to processing based on legitimate interests
- **Withdraw Consent** — Withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing

To exercise any of these rights, email us at **privacy@junkiescoder.com**. We will respond within 30 days.

---

## 9. International Data Transfers

Your data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside your jurisdiction. When we transfer data internationally, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission.

---

## 10. Children's Privacy

Replai is not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we discover that a child has provided us with personal data, we will delete it promptly.

---

## 11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will notify you via email or through the platform. Your continued use of the Service after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

---

## 12. Google Workspace & Google Sheets Add-on Integration

When you install and authorize the **Replai for Google Sheets** add-on from the Google Workspace Marketplace:

1. **Google API Compliance & Limited Use:** Replai's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs adheres to the [Google API Services User Data Policy](https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements.
2. **Narrow Scope:** The add-on requests only `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets.currentonly`. It can only read the specific spreadsheet you actively open it in and has zero access to your Google Drive, emails, contacts, or other documents.
3. **No AI Model Training:** We do not use Google Workspace data or your spreadsheet rows to train generalized AI or machine learning models.
4. **No Sale of Data:** We never sell, rent, or trade your spreadsheet content or customer contact data to third parties or data brokers.
5. **Dedicated Add-on Privacy Policy:** For complete details regarding data processing, OAuth consent, and security practices specific to the Google Sheets integration, review our dedicated [Google Sheets Add-on Privacy Policy](/integrations/google-sheets/privacy).

---

## 13. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us:

- **Email:** privacy@junkiescoder.com
- **Company:** Junkies Coder
- **Website:** [https://junkiescoder.com](https://junkiescoder.com)

title: Terms of Service
content_markdown:
## 1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using the Replai platform ("Service"), operated by **Junkies Coder**, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use the Service.

These Terms apply to all users of the Service, including workspace owners, team members, and administrators.

---

## 2. Description of Service

Replai is an AI-powered WhatsApp CRM platform that enables businesses to:

- Manage WhatsApp Business API conversations in a shared team inbox
- Create and manage contacts, deals, and sales pipelines
- Build and deploy automated messaging workflows
- Use AI-assisted features for message drafting and customer engagement
- Send broadcast messages using pre-approved templates
- Manage team roles, permissions, and access controls

The Service integrates with Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform and is subject to Meta's own terms and policies.

---

## 3. Account Registration

### 3.1 Eligibility
You must be at least 18 years old and have the legal authority to enter into these Terms on behalf of yourself or the organization you represent.

### 3.2 Account Security
- You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials
- You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account
- You are responsible for all activity that occurs under your account
- We recommend enabling strong passwords and practicing good security hygiene

### 3.3 Account Information
You agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information during registration and to keep this information updated.

---

## 4. WhatsApp Business API Compliance

As a user of Replai, you agree to comply with:

- **Meta's WhatsApp Business Policy** — Including messaging limits, template guidelines, and prohibited content
- **Meta's Commerce Policy** — For any commercial transactions conducted through WhatsApp
- **24-Hour Messaging Window** — You may only send free-form messages within 24 hours of the last customer-initiated message. Outside this window, only pre-approved templates may be used.
- **Opt-In Requirements** — You must obtain explicit, verifiable consent from customers before sending proactive messages
- **AI Usage Policy (2026)** — AI features must be used for specific, purpose-driven tasks only. General-purpose AI chatbots are prohibited per Meta's updated policy.

Violation of Meta's policies may result in your WhatsApp Business account being suspended or permanently banned by Meta, which is outside Replai's control.

---

## 5. Acceptable Use

You agree **not** to use the Service to:

- Send unsolicited bulk messages (spam)
- Distribute malware, phishing links, or harmful content
- Impersonate other businesses, organizations, or individuals
- Violate any applicable laws or regulations
- Circumvent rate limits, messaging restrictions, or security measures
- Harvest or scrape contact data without proper consent
- Use AI features to generate misleading, deceptive, or illegal content
- Share login credentials with unauthorized parties

See our full [Acceptable Use Policy](/legal/acceptable-use-policy) for details.

---

## 6. Intellectual Property

### 6.1 Our Rights
The Service, including its design, code, features, and branding, is the property of Junkies Coder and is protected by intellectual property laws. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or reverse-engineer any part of the Service.

### 6.2 Your Content
You retain ownership of all content you upload, create, or transmit through the Service (messages, contacts, templates, etc.). By using the Service, you grant us a limited license to host, store, and process this content solely for the purpose of providing the Service.

---

## 7. Payment and Billing

- Pricing and billing terms are presented at the time of purchase or subscription
- All fees are non-refundable unless otherwise stated or required by law
- We reserve the right to modify pricing with 30 days' advance notice
- Failure to pay may result in suspension or termination of your account

---

## 8. Service Availability

- We strive to maintain 99.9% uptime but do not guarantee uninterrupted access
- We may perform scheduled maintenance with reasonable advance notice
- We are not liable for downtime caused by Meta's WhatsApp Business API, third-party services, or force majeure events

---

## 9. Termination

### 9.1 By You
You may terminate your account at any time through the platform settings or by contacting support.

### 9.2 By Us
We may suspend or terminate your account if you:
- Violate these Terms or our Acceptable Use Policy
- Engage in fraudulent or illegal activity
- Fail to pay applicable fees
- Receive repeated policy violations from Meta

Upon termination, your data will be retained for 30 days to allow for export, after which it will be permanently deleted.

---

## 10. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law:

- Replai is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind
- We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages
- Our total liability shall not exceed the amount you paid for the Service in the preceding 12 months
- We are not responsible for actions taken by Meta regarding your WhatsApp Business account

---

## 11. Indemnification

You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Junkies Coder, its officers, employees, and affiliates from any claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the Service, violation of these Terms, or infringement of any third-party rights.

---

## 12. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. Any disputes arising from these Terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in India.

---

## 13. Changes to Terms

We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. Material changes will be communicated via email or through the platform at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance.

---

## 14. Google Workspace & Google Sheets Add-on Terms

If you install and use the **Replai for Google Sheets** add-on:

1. **License & Permitted Use:** We grant you a revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the add-on in accordance with Google Workspace Marketplace policies and applicable WhatsApp Business messaging rules.
2. **Opt-In & Anti-Spam Compliance:** You must ensure all recipients on your spreadsheets have explicitly opted in to receive WhatsApp communications. Automated triggers or broadcasts must not violate Meta's messaging limits, commerce policies, or Anti-Spam laws.
3. **Dedicated Integration Terms:** For additional rights, obligations, acceptable use policies, and SLA conditions governing the add-on, review our dedicated [Google Sheets Add-on Terms of Service](/integrations/google-sheets/terms).

---
